content: Yinni Gusunɔ u kpɑm kɑ Yeremi ɡɑri kuɑ sɑnɑm mɛ u wɑ̃ɑ pirisɔm sɔɔ.
U nɛɛ, nɛ wi nɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ, nɛ wi nɑ tem tɑkɑ kuɑ mɑ nɑ mu nɛni, nɛnɑ nɑ nɛɛ,
ɑ mɑn sokuo, kon nun wurɑri. Kon nun ɡɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑ ɑsiriɡinu sɔ̃ɔsi ni ɑ ǹ yɛ̃.
Nɛ Gusunɔ, Isirelibɑn Yinni, nɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ ni nɑ kĩ ɑ nɔ, Yerusɑlɛmun diɑ kɑ sere Yudɑbɑn sinɑ kpɑɑnun sɔ̃, ni Bɑbiloniɡibɑ wɔri bɑ sururɑ.
Mɑ be bɑ kɑ Bɑbiloniɡii be tɑbu kuɑ, ben ɡonu yibɑ wuu ɡe sɔɔ, nɛn mɔru bɑkɑn sɔ̃, domi Yerusɑlɛmuɡibu bɑ kɔ̃sɑ kuɑ sere nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kĩ n wuu ɡe wɑ.
Wee, sɑɑ ɡɑɑ sisi yè sɔɔ kon ɡu nɔɔri nɡe bɑrɔ. Kon ɡu bɛkiɑ n bwɑ̃ɑ dorɑsiɑ, kpɑ n de ɡen tɔmbu bɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ.
Kon de be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ Yudɑn di, ben wɑ̃ɑru tu kɔsi, kpɑ n bu swĩi nɡe yellu.
Kon bu ben durum kpuro wɔkɑ ye bɑ mɑn koosi. Kon ben torɑ ni bɑ mɑn torɑri sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ mɑn seesi suuru kuɑ.

Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, nɑ kon nuku dobu mɔ Yerusɑlɛmun sɔ̃, kpɑ yɑ n nɛn yĩsiru bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ɛmɔ, kpɑ bwese tukunu nu n mɑn siɑrɑmɔ. Bwese ni, nù n wɑ durom bɑkɑm mɛ kon ye kuɑ kɑ doo nɔɔ te kon ye wɛ̃, nu koo biti ko sere nu diiri.
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ Yudɑbɑ, i nɛɛ, bɛɛn tem mu kuɑ bɑnsu. Tɔmbu kɑ yɛɛ mɑɑ sɑri mi. Mɑ Yerusɑlɛmu kɑ Yudɑbɑn wusun swɛɛ yi kuɑ swɛɛ ɡonu yi ɡoo ku rɑ mɑɑ sĩ.
Adɑmɑ bɑ koo wure bu nuku dobun kuuki nɔ kɑ tɔ̃ɔ bɑkɑruɡii. Bɑ koo kurɔ kpɑɑnun womusu nɔ. Bɑ koo mɑɑ wure bu womu ɡeni nɔ, ɡe ɡɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: i Gusunɔ, wɔllu kɑ tem Yinni siɑro.
Win kĩru tɑ ǹ nɔru mɔ.

content: Mɛyɑ bɑ koo mɑɑ tɔn be bɑ kɑ yɑ̃kunu nɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerɔn womusu nɔ. Domi kon de tɔn be bɑ rɑɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ mi, bu wurɑmɑ tem mɛ sɔɔ, kpɑ n bu wesiɑ nɡe yellu. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, tem mɛ, mu rɑɑ kuɑ bɑnsu mi ɡoo sɑri, yɑɑ sɑbenu sɑri mɛn wusu kpuro sɔɔ. Adɑmɑ tɛ̃, yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobu bɑ koo wɑ̃ɑ yeru wɑ mi, kpɑ ben yɑɑ sɑbenu nu wɛ̃rɑ.

Yɑ̃ɑ kpɑrobu bɑ koo mɑɑ yɑ̃ɑnu kpɑrɑ bɑɑmɑ kpuro wuu si su wɑ̃ɑ ɡuunun berɑ ɡiɑ kɑ si su wɑ̃ɑ wɔwi sɔɔ, kɑ si su wɑ̃ɑ sɔ̃ɔ yɛ̃sɑn nɔm dwɑru ɡiɑ, kɑ Bɛnyɑmɛɛn temɔ kɑ Yerusɑlɛmun bɑru kpɑɑnɔ kɑ Yudɑbɑn wusɔ. Nɛ, Yinni Gusunɔwɑ nɑ yeni ɡeruɑ.
Gusunɔ
ku rɑ win nɔɔ mwɛɛru kɔbie
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ, tɔ̃rɑ sisi tè sɔɔ kon nɛn nɔɔ mwɛɛ ɡee ni yibiɑ ni nɑ Isirelibɑ kɑ Yudɑbɑ kuɑ.
Sɑɑ ye, yɑ̀ n tunumɑ, kon ɡoo seeyɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ kpii pɔturɑ Dɑfidin bweseru sɔɔ u n sɑ̃ɑ ɡemɡii, kpɑ u tɔmbu kpɑrɑ ɡem sɔɔ.
Yen tɔ̃ɔ te, Yuubɑ bɑ koo fɑɑbɑ wɑ kpɑ Yerusɑlɛmu yɑ n wɑ̃ɑ bɔri yɛndu sɔɔ, kpɑ bu ye yĩsiru kɛ̃, Yinni Gusunɔn miyɑ bɛsɛn ɡem wɑ̃ɑ.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ nɛɛ, Dɑfidi sinɑ boko u ǹ ɡoo biɑmɔ wi u koo sinɑ win bweserun sinɑ ɡɔnɑɔ Isireliɔ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ Lefibɑ be bɑ sɑ̃ɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu, bɑ ǹ kɔsire biɑmɔ ben bweseru sɔɔ bu kɑ mɑn yɑ̃ku dɔ̃ɔ mwɑɑrɑruɡinu kuɑ, kpɑ bu mɑn turɑre dɔ̃ɔ dokeɑ kpɑ bɑ n dɑ yɑ̃kunu ko tɔ̃ɔ bɑɑtere.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
nɛnɑ nɑ kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ. Ì n ko i kpĩ i yen ɡɑɑ yɔ̃rɑsiɑ yu ku mɑɑ sɔmburu ko yen sɑɑ sɔɔ, kpɑ yu nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni ye kusiɑ,

sɑɑ yerɑ nɛn tii, kon mɑɑ nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑ ye nɑ kɑ Dɑfidi nɛn sɔm kowo bɔkuɑ, kpɑ u kɔsire biɑ win bweseru sɔɔ wi u koo bɑndu di. Kon mɑɑ nɛn ɑrukɑwɑni kusiɑ ye nɑ kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobu Lefin bweseru bɔkuɑ be bɑ rɑ sɔmburu ko nɛn sɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Adɑmɑ n ǹ koorɔ mɛ. Kon Dɑfidin bweseru kɑ yɑ̃ku kowobun bweseru dɑbiɑsiɑwɑ nɡe kperi, ǹ kun mɛ nɡe yɑni sɛɛri yi yi wɑ̃ɑ dɑɑrun ɡoorɔ yi bɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ bu ɡɑri.
Yinni Gusunɔ u mɑɑ Yeremi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
ɑ ǹ nɔɔmɔ ye tɔmbɑ ɡerumɔ? Bɑ mɔ̀, nɑ Isirelibɑn bweseru kɑ Yudɑbɑn bweseru ni nɑ ɡɔsɑ biru kisi. Yen sɔ̃nɑ bɑ bu ɡɛmɑ, bɑ ǹ bu ɡɑrisi bweseru.
Adɑmɑ wee ye nɑ ɡerumɔ, nɛ wi nɑ kɑ sɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ kɑ wɔ̃kuru ɑrukɑwɑni bɔkuɑ, mɑ nɑ wɔllu kɑ tem woodɑ yiiyɑ,

nɛnɑ kon Isirelibɑn bweseru kɑ Dɑfidi nɛn sɔm kowon bweseru biru kisi? Kpɑ nɑ kun win bweseru sɔɔ ɡoo ɡɔsɑ u bɑndu di Aburɑhɑmu kɑ Isɑki kɑ Yɑkɔbun bweserun suunu sɔɔ? Aɑwo. Kon ben wɔnwɔndu ko be bɑ yoru mwɛɛrɑ mi, kpɑ n de bu wurɑmɑ.
Gɑri yi Yinni Gusunɔ
u Sedesiɑsi sɔ̃ɔwɑ
